free_tier.stated: Hourly list prices in EUR on the vendor's Cloud Server GPU page, the same figure printed under its Standard and Spot headings: H100 (GPU SXM, 320 GB GPU RAM, 128 cores, 1,024 GB RAM) EUR 1.89; A100 (GPU PCI, 80 GB) EUR 0.99; L40S 48 GB EUR 0.85; L4 24 GB EUR 0.38; RTX A6000 48 GB EUR 0.74; Quadro RTX 6000 and A30 EUR 0.29 each.
